name: Skagi hf.
summary: Operating from its headquarters in Reykjavik, Iceland, Skagi hf. offers a broad spectrum of insurance products and services throughout the country. The company's diverse portfolio encompasses core offerings such as property, marine and cargo, mandatory and other vehicle insurance, general liability, and accident, health, and life policies. Skagi hf. also engages in foreign reinsurance and provides specialized coverage for family and home contents, travel, animals, bicycles, mountain sports and hiking, golf, musical instruments, and electric scooters, along with various special risk options. Established in 1917, the firm was known as Vátryggingafélag Íslands hf. before officially changing its name to Skagi hf. in January 2025.
